[From the in-game character description]

[spoiler]She is revealed to be the culprit of the present-day HB Case, having killed [url=/c112135]the original culprit, Tearer[/url], as revenge for [url=/c107324]her father[/url]'s death, and then blackmailed into aiding the Nirvana Initiative.[/spoiler]
